name: Thunder Lizards
description: Dinosaur music built for headphones: a Triassic swamp breathing all around you, a tyrant whose footsteps close in from behind, sauropods humming far overhead, pteranodons circling your head, a raptor pack hunting from both sides, a stegosaurus stomp split between the ears, a triceratops herd that drifts apart in cents, a volcano widened by delays, a mosasaur rolling in the deep, fossil voices hidden in the wind and a last day that plays once and ends in a new dawn. The heaviest things stay in the centre while the creatures use the space around you. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume sensible.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Triassic Swamp
sketches.description: Headphones on: humid swamp air that is different in each ear, bubbles rising from the mud on every side, giant dragonflies circling your head and a far-off call across the water, over a 6 Hz binaural drone in the theta range. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: The Tyrant Approaches
sketches.description: Eight bars of dread: the footsteps start far behind you and close in, swinging round to the front as they get nearer, while the strings climb and your heartbeat doubles. On the eighth bar it roars, right in front of your face.

sketches.name: Brachiosaurus Lullaby
sketches.description: Headphones on: the sauropods graze high above the treetops, humming slowly as they drift from side to side over your head, over a 2 Hz binaural drone in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning.

sketches.name: Pteranodon Glide
sketches.description: Over the cliffs: wingbeats circle your head once every two bars, shrieks wheel the other way, the sea crashes far below you and soaring Lydian strings lift everything up.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// Wingbeats: soft whooshes circling your head once every two bars, high up
wings: s("pink*4").hpf(500).lpf(2500).attack(.1).release(.3)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).elevation(45).distance(3).posglide(.3).gain(.06)

// Shrieks wheeling the other way, slower and further out
shrieks: note("<~ [c6@2 g5@2 ~@4] ~ [eb6 c6 ~ ~]>").s("sine").timbre("reed")
  .mono(1).glide(.06).vib(7).vibdepth(.3).attack(.02).sustain(.5).release(.3)
  .azimuth(isaw.range(-180, 180).slow(4)).elevation(35).distance(6).posglide(.3).gain(.1)

// The sea far below you
sea: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.5).elevation(-40).distance(8).gain(.2)

// Soaring strings and a wide pad, centred: D, E/D, Bm, G
strings: note("<[a4@3 b4 c#5@2 e5@2] [f#5@4 e5@2 d5@2] [d5@2 c#5 b4 a4@4] [g#4@4 a4@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).vib(5).vibdepth(.1).lpf(3000)
  .attack(.2).sustain(.7).release(.6).room(.6).gain(.18)
pad: note("<[d3,a3,f#4] [d3,b3,g#4] [b2,f#3,d4] [g2,d3,b3]>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.25)
  .attack(.5).release(1.5).lpf(1600).room(.6).gain(.12)

// Timpani on the downbeat, a bass rising with the thermals
drums: s("lt ~ ~ lt ~ ~ lt ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~").room(.4).gain(.38)
bass: note("<d2 d2 b1 g1>").s("sine").attack(.1).sustain(.7).release(.5).gain(.36)

sketches.name: Raptor Pack
sketches.description: Clever girls: claws click on stone and hop between your ears at random, one raptor calls from your left, one answers from your right and a third, the one you forgot, chirps from behind you. Only the kick and bass stay in the middle.

sketches.name: Stegosaurus Stomp
sketches.description: A heavy, plodding groove where the kit sends its lows to one ear and its highs to the other, the brass stabs send alternate partials to each ear, and the tail spikes swing from side to side on tiny delays. Together, and in mono, the beast is whole.

sketches.name: Triceratops Herd
sketches.description: A herd crossing the plain: their lowing drone drifts apart between the ears in cents, a bar at a time, from a slow beat to a wide chorus, while hooves fall all around you and a horn calls across the valley.

sketches.name: Volcano Dawn
sketches.description: A volcano wakes: lava hisses differently in each ear, the stabs grow wider each bar as their delay rises from 1 to 25 milliseconds, and a string pad steps from the centre of your head out into a haze. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the pad nearly vanish.

sketches.name: Mosasaur Deep
sketches.description: Underwater in the Cretaceous sea: the surface is muffled far above you, bubbles drift past, a huge shape calls from the dark and the drone's phase between the ears rolls slowly around inside your head, staying below the rates that trigger a pulse warning.

sketches.name: Fossil Voices
sketches.description: A night in the museum's fossil hall. The wind gusting through the skeletons is white noise, but between the ears it carries a faint theme (Huggins pitch). Each ear alone hears only hiss. A quiet hum plays the first bar every four bars so you know what to listen for. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: The Last Day
sketches.description: Listen through once. For four bars a meteor whistles down from high on your left while the noise in your ears spreads from a point into a wash; on bar five it lands. Then ash falls, the rumble fades, insects and tiny mammals come out, and a 2 Hz delta drone opens on a new dawn.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// Bars 1-4: the riser. icorr 1 is the same noise in both ears, near 0 is unrelated noise in each
riser: s("pink").icorr("<1 .7 .4 .1>").hpf(saw.range(200, 4000).slow(4))
  .gain("<.04 .07 .1 .14>").exit(4)

// The meteor whistles down from high on the left towards the front
meteor: freq(isaw.range(300, 3000).slow(4).segment(16)).s("sine").mono(1).glide(.2)
  .azimuth(isaw.range(-150, 0).slow(4)).elevation(isaw.range(10, 80).slow(4)).posglide(.3)
  .attack(.01).sustain(1).release(.05).exit(4).gain(.05)

// The last song of the dinosaurs
choir: note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,ab2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>").s("choir").syl("<oo ah oo oh>")
  .attack(1).release(2).space("hall").exit(4).gain(.24)

// Bar 5: impact, then the rumble fades over four bars
impact: s("[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~").speed(.3).lpf(400).room(.9).size(.95).enter(4).exit(5).gain(.8)
rumble: s("brown").slow(4).lpf(500).icorr(.1).enter(4).gain(.25).fadeout(4, 4)

// Ash falling, then the survivors creep out
ash: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.3).enter(5).gain(.12)
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(60).distance(4).enter(6).gain(.08)
mammals: note("<[c6 ~ e6 ~] ~ [g6 e6 ~ ~] ~>").s("sine").decay(.06).sustain(0)
  .azimuth("<-50 40>").distance(2).enter(6).gain(.08)

// A new dawn: a 2 Hz binaural drone, below the 3-30 Hz warning range, and a glass melody
dawn: note("[c2,g2]").slow(4).s("sine").binaural(2).attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).enter(7).gain(.2)
hope: n("<[0 ~ 2 4] [5 ~ 4 ~] [2 ~ 0 ~] [4@4]>").scale("C:major").transpose(12)
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(1).sustain(0).release(1.5).room(.6).enter(8).gain(.14)
